provenance.paper_title: DexScale: Automating Data Scaling for Sim2Real Generalizable Robot Control
provenance.license: Official PMLR source; specific reuse license not independently verified
provenance.notes: Original four-stage data engine pipeline. Native editable panels, decision/ranking boxes, control paths and ordinary labels. Fifteen original icons/scene/trajectory inserts remain separate raster objects; internal details of the neural-network icon remain raster.
provenance.extraction_review: pending; native geometry extraction is not visual fidelity approval
provenance.font_substitutions: Arial or Courier New; source fonts recorded per text object
provenance.dash_fidelity: PPTX uses the closest supported native preset, not exact PDF dash lengths. Draw.io retains interval lengths; PDF phase/caps are not preserved; zero intervals become 0.001 scene units.
extraction_warnings: 14 source clipping groups intersect crop; extracted paths require explicit clipping review
provenance.text_repairs: Source Aptos fragments merged into live complete labels and fitted Arial metrics. Raw source image objects replace rendered crops to avoid baking duplicate portions of adjacent native labels.
